verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an `ai_query` parameter for describing in natural language what to extract, and `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules`. The docs recommend AI extraction when fields are semantic or page structure is irregular, which covers the core of selector-free LLM extraction. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the structured output format/schema of `ai_extract_rules`, evidence that the LLM can choose which fields to return rather than only filling user-named ones, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
